metadata.description: Skills for making web games with a coding agent: general game-making craft, and everything specific to PushPlay.

plugins.name: game-craft
plugins.description: Game-making skills for any game: design briefs and design docs, building in checked pieces, game feel, levels, enemy AI, art direction, art styles (papercraft, claymation, toon, voxel and more), pixel art, 3D models in code and from Blender scripts, assets and licences, lighting, first-person viewmodels, audio, UI, playtesting and performance.

plugins.name: pushplay
plugins.description: Make games for the PushPlay launcher: start a whole game project from one request, the manifest, runtime files, library art, phone and party play, and the build kit. Works together with game-craft.
